text.11:105: On the day when it cometh no soul will speak except by His permission; some among them will be wretched, (others) glad.
text.24:16: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.
text.30:35: Or have We revealed unto them any warrant which speaketh of that which they associate with Him?
text.78:38: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
